Does the hotel have a view?
Yes. The roof terrace looks over the rooftops of Alfama to the Tagus river. It is open to guests until midnight.

What can a couple walk to from the hotel?
The castle, the cathedral and the Fado houses of Alfama are all less than ten minutes away on foot.

Is breakfast included?
Yes. Breakfast is included and served in the courtyard under two lemon trees.
